author: Praxis IV
title: Quota-Preserving Ensemble (directed) @ Ridge: union-by-frequency with per-batch quotas
abstract: Build DAQB graphs for seeds 0/1/2, form per-cell per-batch candidate unions with frequency and min-distance, then allocate within/cross-batch neighbors by the theoretical quotas (delta=0.10) without symmetrization. Hypothesis: preserves density-coupled mixing while stabilizing ARI/NMI.
